prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1311; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in the north parking lot of the retail center. Insured vehicle reversed into a stationary sedan while backing from a space. Claimant reports a knee injury from exiting her vehicle after the impact. No attorney representation noted at intake. Initial recorded statement scheduled.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. She confirms she is handling the matter herself and has not retained counsel. Describes pain in the right knee and difficulty bearing weight in the morning. Advised her of medical evaluation options and that she may seek treatment with her own provider. Photos of both vehicles requested.

Entry 3: Photos received. Damage to rear bumper of insured vehicle and driver-side door of claimant vehicle is consistent with the reported angle of impact. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from property management. Insured's statement obtained and matches the account given by claimant.

Entry 4: Claimant submitted treatment notes from her primary care provider documenting a knee sprain with swelling and limited range of motion. Imaging ordered by provider is pending. Reviewed policy limits for bodily injury coverage. Explained claims process and documentation needed to proceed with the injury portion of the claim.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. She reports the knee is improving with rest and physical therapy referral. Imaging results still awaited. Liability appears clear based on photos and insured's statement. Will continue evaluation of medical documentation before making any settlement recommendation. File remains open.
